verses.text: Once the whole nation had crossed the Jordan, Yahweh spoke to Joshua: 🗣️
‘Pick twelve people from the crowd—one from each tribe, 👥
‘and tell them: “Head to the middle of the Jordan, where the priests stood firm. Each of you grab a stone and carry it to the camp where we stay tonight.”’ 🪨
So Joshua called up the twelve men he’d picked, one from each Israelite tribe. 📣
He told them, ‘Go ahead of the ark of Yahweh your God, right into the Jordan. Each of you, hoist a stone onto your shoulder—one for every Israelite tribe. 🪨
‘These stones will be a sign for you. Later, when your kids ask, “What do these stones mean?” 🤔
‘tell them, “The Jordan stopped flowing in front of Yahweh’s covenant ark. When the ark crossed the river, the water stopped. These stones will keep Israel remembering what went down.”’ 💧

The Israelites did exactly what Joshua told them. They picked up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, one for each tribe, just as Yahweh had said. They hauled them to camp and set them down. ✅
Joshua also set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, right where the priests carrying the covenant ark had stood. They’re still there today. 🪨
The priests carrying the ark stayed in the Jordan until every instruction Yahweh gave Joshua for the people was done—just as Moses had told Joshua. Meanwhile, the people hurried across. 🚶
When everybody had crossed, Yahweh’s ark came over too, with the priests leading the way in front of the whole crowd. 📦
Reuben’s and Gad’s tribes, plus half of Manasseh’s tribe, crossed armed ahead of the Israelites, just as Moses had told them. 🛡️
About 40,000 armed men, battle-ready, crossed before Yahweh toward the plains of Jericho. 🪖
That day Yahweh made Joshua great in the eyes of all Israel. They respected him just like they had respected Moses his whole life. 👑
Then Yahweh spoke to Joshua: 🗣️
‘Tell the priests carrying the covenant ark, “Come up out of the Jordan.”’ 📣
So Joshua called to the priests, ‘Come up out of the Jordan!’ 🗣️
When the priests carrying Yahweh’s covenant ark came up from the middle of the river and their feet hit dry ground, the water rushed back into place and overflowed its banks like before. 🌊
The people came up from the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month and set up camp at Gilgal, east of Jericho. 🏕️
Joshua set up at Gilgal the twelve stones they’d carried out of the Jordan. 🪨
He told the Israelites, ‘Later, when your kids ask their parents, “What do these stones mean?” 🤔
‘tell them, “Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground. 👣
‘“Yahweh your God dried up the Jordan’s water for you until you crossed, just like Yahweh your God dried up the Red Sea for us until we crossed it, 🌊
‘“so everybody on earth can know Yahweh’s hand is mighty, and you can honor Yahweh your God forever.”’ 💪
